#+TITLE: Tokenizer corpus -- org markup
#+OPTIONS: toc:nil num:t

A frozen sample of the org markup this repo actually writes, kept as a fixture
so the bulk parity check has stable input.  Do not edit: changing it makes the
digest in =test/fixtures/qwen-tokenizer-bulk.eld= stale, which the suite
reports as a failure until the fixture is regenerated.

* Headings and inline markup
Nested =code=, /emphasis/, *bold*, ~verbatim~, +strikethrough+ and a
[[https://example.com][link with a label]].
